{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Administration has increased investment in Community Development Financial Institutions (CDFIs) and Minority Depository Institutions (MDIs).",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration issued new licenses for nonbank lenders.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Issuing new licenses for nonbank lenders helps more people in underserved communities to get capital and start businesses.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Vice President Harris launched the Economic Opportunity Coalition, bringing together major corporations and foundations.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Economic Opportunity Coalition aims to align public and private sector investments.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Economic Opportunity Coalition has a particular focus on driving private investment in CDFIs and MDIs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Investing in community lenders is driving an estimated $130 billion more in loans to Black and Latino communities over the next decade.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Funding for CDFIs will be doubled going forward.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The New Markets Tax Credit will be expanded and made permanent.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Expanding and making permanent the New Markets Tax Credit aims to encourage development in places too long left behind.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The American Rescue Plan provided $4 billion of debt forgiveness for Black and other “socially disadvantaged” farmers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Black and other “socially disadvantaged” farmers have endured decades of discrimination from banks and the federal government.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump's MAGA allies brought lawsuits that blocked $4 billion of debt forgiveness for Black and other “socially disadvantaged” farmers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats secured over $5 billion in the Inflation Reduction Act to provide financial assistance to farmers, ranchers and forest landowners who've faced discrimination.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Inflation Reduction Act provides financial assistance to farmers, ranchers and forest landowners who've faced discrimination.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Inflation Reduction Act covers loan payments for farmers in financial distress.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Over $2 billion has already been distributed to more than 40,000 people.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Agriculture Department estimates that Black and underserved farmers have benefited most.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
